requirements.description: User prefers properties near public transport (metro, bus, stations). 'Near' maps to the 75th percentile of the mobility distribution (70.93, rounded to 71).

The user explicitly requires at least 180 sqm of gross floor area. The 14-person capacity is not converted into an area filter because no verified gross-area threshold per occupant was supplied. Turin and public-transport proximity are location criteria handled by the Location Agent, and the energy class requirement is excluded.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Attività scolastiche' AND surface_area >= 180 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 AND mobility >= 71 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters school-type properties (property_type 'Attività scolastiche') with surface_area of at least 180 sqm, within 3.0 km of the supplied coordinates, and mobility score of at least 71. The 14-person capacity and energy class are not mapped because no matching column exists and energy class is not required. Results are ordered by distance from the coordinates.
